note_content = '''# Miami Expense Bookkeeping
Robin owes me => $187
Erika owes me => $288
I owe Troy => $176
I owe Connor => $202
I owe Gina => $108
I owe Joseph => $191
Nancy owes me => $148
Katie owes me => $111'''

lines = [ln.strip() for ln in note_content.splitlines() if '=>' in ln]

owes_me=[]
i_owe=[]
for ln in lines:
    left, right = ln.split('=>')
    left=left.strip()
    amt = float(right.strip().replace('$',''))
    if left.lower().startswith('i owe '):
        name = left[6:].strip()
        i_owe.append({'name':name,'amount':amt})
    elif ' owes me' in left.lower():
        name = left.split(' ')[0].strip()  # before 'owes'
        # more robust: split ' owes me'
        name2 = left[:left.lower().index(' owes me')].strip()
        owes_me.append({'name':name2,'amount':amt})
    else:
        print('unparsed line', ln)

print('owes_me:', owes_me)
print('i_owe:', i_owe)
print('total ops:', len(owes_me)+len(i_owe))

# Parse contacts for each first name via phone.search_contacts(query=name) and post-filter exact first_name
names = ['Robin','Erika','Nancy','Katie','Troy','Connor','Gina','Joseph']

phone_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]

for nm in names:
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    results=[]

        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=nm, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    # post-filter exact first name match (case-insensitive)
    filtered=[c for c in results if c['first_name'].strip().lower()==nm.lower()]
    print(f"{nm}: search returned {len(results)}; after exact first_name filter: {len(filtered)}")

    filtered=[u for u in venmo_results if u.get('email','').strip().lower()==email.strip().lower()]
    print('  exact email matches:', [(u['first_name'],u['last_name'],u['email']) for u in filtered])

        resolved_venmo[nm]=filtered[0]
    else:
        resolved_venmo[nm]=None

print('unresolved venmo:', [k for k,v in resolved_venmo.items() if v is None])

# Criteria Enumeration Gate + payload composition + existing-state check

# Re-read exact task instruction
print("Task asks:", "Make private venmo payments or requests accordingly. In the payments/requests, add a note, 'For Miami trip'.")

# Fetch and parse the Miami trip note from simple_note
sn_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
sn_login = apis.simple_note.login(username='morgan-harrison@gmail.com', password=sn_pw)
sn_token = sn_login['access_token']

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=sn_token)
content = note['content']
print('Note title:', note['title'])

lines=[]
for ln in content.splitlines():
    if '=>' in ln:
        lines.append(ln.strip())
print('Parsed money lines:', lines)

owes_me=[]
i_owe=[]
for ln in lines:
    left, right = ln.split('=>')
    amt = float(right.strip().replace('$',''))
    left = left.strip()
    if left.lower().startswith('i owe '):
        name = left[6:].strip()
        i_owe.append({'source_line': ln, 'name': name, 'amount': amt, 'op_type': 'payment'})
    else:
        idx = left.lower().index(' owes me')
        name = left[:idx].strip()
        owes_me.append({'source_line': ln, 'name': name, 'amount': amt, 'op_type': 'request'})

records = owes_me + i_owe
print('Total records from note:', len(records))

# Identity mapping from prior resolution if available
print('resolved_venmo in globals?', 'resolved_venmo' in globals())
if 'resolved_venmo' in globals():
    resolved_map = resolved_venmo
else:
    resolved_map = {}

# If mapping missing, resolve again via phone->venmo
if len(resolved_map) < len(set([r['name'] for r in records])):
    print('Re-resolving identities because resolved_venmo incomplete...')
    phone_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
    phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='8903665635', password=phone_pw)['access_token']
    venmo_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
    venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='morgan-harrison@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

    names = sorted(set([r['name'] for r in records]))
    resolved_contacts = {}
    for nm in names:
        page_index=0
        page_limit=20
        results=[]
        while True:
            page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=nm, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
            if not page:
                break
            results.extend(page)
            page_index += 1
        filtered=[c for c in results if c['first_name'].strip().lower()==nm.lower()]
        if len(filtered)!=1:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Cannot resolve unique phone contact for {nm}: {len(filtered)} candidates')
        resolved_contacts[nm]=filtered[0]

    resolved_map={}
    for nm,c in resolved_contacts.items():
        email=c.get('email')
        page_index=0
        page_limit=20
        venmo_results=[]
        while True:
            page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
            if not page:
                break
            venmo_results.extend(page)
            page_index += 1
        filtered=[u for u in venmo_results if u.get('email','').strip().lower()==email.strip().lower()]
        if len(filtered)!=1:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Cannot resolve unique Venmo user for {nm}: {len(filtered)} candidates')
        resolved_map[nm]=filtered[0]

# Build target payloads
note_text = 'For Miami trip'
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='morgan-harrison@gmail.com', password=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0])['access_token']

payments_to=[]
requests_to=[]
for r in records:
    nm=r['name']
    email = resolved_map[nm]['email']
    if r['op_type']=='payment':
        payments_to.append({'name':nm,'email':email,'amount':r['amount'],'description':note_text,'private':True,'source_line':r['source_line']})
    else:
        requests_to.append({'name':nm,'email':email,'amount':r['amount'],'description':note_text,'private':True,'source_line':r['source_line']})

print('Identity source used: phone contacts')
print('Number records from note:', len(records))
print('Payments (I owe):', len(payments_to), [p['name'] for p in payments_to])
print('Requests (owes me):', len(requests_to), [p['name'] for p in requests_to])
print('Mapped to Venmo users:', len(payments_to)+len(requests_to))

# Criteria table
print('\nCRITERIA TABLE')
criteria = [
    ('Operation type', "'others owe me' lines: '<Name> owes me => $A'", 'create_payment_request for receiver_email, amount, private=true, description="For Miami trip"'),
    ('Operation type', "'I owe' lines: 'I owe <Name> => $A'", 'create_transaction for receiver_email, amount, private=true, description="For Miami trip"'),
    ('Identity', 'Names resolved via phone contacts', 'phone.search_contacts exact first_name match; then venmo.search_users exact email match')
]
for row in criteria:
    print(row)

# Existing-state check to avoid duplicate actions: look for exact description + amount matches

def fetch_all_sent_payment_requests_with_query(query):
    all_items=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_items.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

def fetch_all_received_payment_requests_with_query(query):
    all_items=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_items.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

def fetch_all_transactions_with_user_email_and_query(user_email, query):
    all_items=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, user_email=user_email, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_items.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

print('\nChecking existing Venmo items with description query:', note_text)

sent_reqs = fetch_all_sent_payment_requests_with_query(note_text)
print('Existing sent_payment_requests matching query count:', len(sent_reqs))
if sent_reqs:
    print('Sample sent_payment_request record:', sent_reqs[0])

# Filter exact matches for our requests
req_exact=set()
for pr in sent_reqs:
    # Identify receiver email
    rec_email = pr.get('receiver',{}).get('email','').strip().lower()
    amt = float(pr.get('amount',0.0))
    desc = pr.get('description','')
    priv = pr.get('private',False)
    if desc==note_text and priv==True:
        for t in requests_to:
            if t['email'].strip().lower()==rec_email and abs(t['amount']-amt) < 1e-6:
                req_exact.add((t['email'].strip().lower(), amt))

print('Exact existing matches for requests (email,amount):', req_exact)

# For payments, check transactions for each recipient email
existing_payments=set()
for p in payments_to:
    txs = fetch_all_transactions_with_user_email_and_query(p['email'], note_text)
    # Determine exact matches: description + amount + private
    for tx in txs:
        desc = tx.get('description','')
        amt = float(tx.get('amount',0.0))
        priv = tx.get('private',False)
        # In Venmo transaction record, sender/receiver depends on direction; we only care receiver email equals p email.
        recv_email = tx.get('receiver',{}).get('email','').strip().lower()
        if desc==note_text and priv==True and recv_email==p['email'].strip().lower() and abs(amt-p['amount'])<1e-6:
            existing_payments.add((p['email'].strip().lower(), amt))
    print('Transactions checked for payment recipient', p['name'], 'email', p['email'], 'total records fetched', len(txs))

print('Exact existing matches for transactions (email,amount):', existing_payments)

# Determine missing sets
requests_missing=[]
for t in requests_to:
    key=(t['email'].strip().lower(), float(t['amount']))
    if key not in req_exact:
        requests_missing.append(t)

payments_missing=[]
for p in payments_to:
    key=(p['email'].strip().lower(), float(p['amount']))
    if key not in existing_payments:
        payments_missing.append(p)

print('\nTarget sets BEFORE existing-state filter:')
print('Requests:', [(t['name'], t['amount']) for t in requests_to])
print('Payments:', [(t['name'], t['amount']) for t in payments_to])

print('\nNeed ACTION (missing):')
